snippet.title: Demon Slayer Shion - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Shion ventures into a certain dungeon where her fellow Demon Slayer, Ayano, had disappeared. With the help of her friends Hinako and Karin, they explore the depths of this enormous dungeon, crawling with otherworldly creatures. Will they find out what became of Ayano, or will they succumb to the grotesque nature of this dungeon..?
